strips.title: Moon Market Setting Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing strip for choosing one small desk setting clue: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print the strip, place it beside a pencil, and invite one quick market sketch before the writer fills this blank: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Imagine a pretend moon market on the writing desk, then choose one gentle place detail to write here: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Strip front: The Moon Muffin Market stall sits beside ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Strip back: This setting clue makes the market feel ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A tiny market sign points toward ____________________, and a small story begins.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: At the moon market, I noticed ____________________, then the stall changed because ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one plain place word with a clearer setting word: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch one stall shape first, then label it here: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At another table, add one new moon market detail: ____________________.

strips.title: Puddle Planet Character Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing strip for inventing one helper and one choice: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print the strip, set out a pencil, and ask for a tiny helper badge sketch before this blank is filled: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Imagine a pretend message helper at the Puddle Planet Post Office, then choose the helper's job: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Strip front: My Puddle Planet helper sorts pretend messages by ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Strip back: The helper's careful habit is ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: One pretend message slides past ____________________, and the helper decides what to do next.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: The puddle helper checked ____________________, then chose ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one exact character action a reader can picture: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the helper badge, then write one character word: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, invent one more pretend message for ____________________.

strips.title: Buttonwood Train Sequence Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing strip for arranging a beginning, turn, and finish: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print the strip and draw three small boxes on scrap paper if helpful; the writer starts with this clue: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Imagine the Buttonwood Library Train has three shelf clues out of order, then choose the first one: ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The library train rolls past ____________________, but the next shelf clue changes the route.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one reason the middle clue belongs after the first: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number three small boxes and fill only box one: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, retell the train route with a new final clue: ____________________.

strips.title: Pencil Dragon Academy Object Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing strip for giving one desk object a story job: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print the strip, point to one ordinary pencil or paper tool, and keep the invented object name here: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Imagine Pencil Dragon Academy keeps a tiny desk tool for story practice, then name the object: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Strip front: The academy desk object is called ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Strip back: This object helps the scene by ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A pencil dragon finds ____________________ on the desk and uses it to solve a small story mix-up.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: On the academy desk, ____________________ waited beside ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one vague object word with an exact noun: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the object silently, then write its tiny job: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At another desk, add a second helpful object called ____________________.

strips.title: Teacup Weather Sensory Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing strip for adding color, sound, or texture to a scene: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print the strip near a table or window view and ask for one pretend sensory clue before this blank: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Imagine Teacup Town watches a weather window on the writing desk, then choose one clue readers can picture: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Strip front: The weather window glows the color of ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Strip back: The tiny weather sound is ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: When the window showed ____________________, Teacup Town changed one small plan.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: The teacup window clicked softly as ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one sensory word that makes the weather clue clearer: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw one tiny weather mark and label its feeling: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, add a new color, sound, or texture to ____________________.

strips.title: Pocket Park Revision Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing strip for improving one short notice-board sentence: ____________________.
strips.adultSetup: Print the strip, ask for one draft line, and invite the writer to make one detail clearer here: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Imagine the Pocket Park notice board has a sentence that almost works, then choose one word to improve: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Strip front: My draft notice says ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Strip back: The clearer detail I can add is ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A new notice appears beside ____________________, and one sentence needs a sharper clue.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Circle one word to keep, then replace one dull word with ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Rewrite only one word from the draft here: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At home, revise one pocket park sentence about ____________________.
